scene_description: A brown cardboard ELEGOO filament spool lies flat on a scuffed wooden workbench with clear safety glasses resting across its upper flange and center hole. An orange scraper lies beneath the front lower rim: its narrow handle is underneath the spool and its broad head projects toward the camera.

vlm_input.task_context: The robot will collect the empty brown ELEGOO filament spool and carry it to a nearby recycling collection tray. The scraper and glasses will remain in the work area.
vlm_input.robot_context: The robot has one claw gripper with parallel jaws and handles one object at a time. It grips an exposed upper-flange segment between opposing jaw contacts and initially lifts vertically. Assume compatible jaw opening, tip clearance, reach and payload. guidance_specs.target_object: clear safety glasses resting across the upper flange and center hole of the brown ELEGOO spool

qualifiers.reference_object: brown ELEGOO filament spool resting over the orange scraper handle

constraints: Lift the frame free of the flange rather than scrape the lenses along it
Keep the glasses supported by hand and clear of the spool motion until it has been moved

review.problem: The glasses rest on the upper flange of the spool the robot will transport.
review.rationale: Removing the supported glasses first prevents their being carried or dropped with the spool. The vertical initial lift releases the scraper handle beneath the lower flange without sweeping the scraper sideways.
review.notes: All three unchanged photographs were visually reviewed; only image 01 is supplied as input. Task contexts and task-specific grasp capabilities are authored scenario assumptions, not robot logs or measured outcomes. Legacy T001. The collector supplied a 10 cm rightward displacement with the spool as reference. The move uses direction plus reference_object, preserving displacement semantics. The human supports the relocated glasses clear of the spool through its removal or repositioning; no unprovided numeric vertical drop is invented. REVIEW BEFORE SFT: verify frame clearance at the supplied lateral offset; a modeled anchor shift alone does not verify that the entire glasses frame clears the spool. The scraper handle is under the lower rim and the broad head projects toward the camera, contrary to the old blade-under wording. No separate scraper move is needed for the stated vertical spool pickup.
